audit.why: 57.69% over 26 games with a chart of Skill / Pantheon / Pantheon / Skill / Skill / Pantheon / Pantheon — an early bully Galio survives and then beats on tempo. The verdict holds; the mechanics under it did not.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two strings call Hero's Entrance global, and Grand Starfall is dismissed as 'his own ult on a single target'.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140 onto an ALLY within 4000/4750/5500. Grand Starfall is 180/165/150 at range 5500 and Riot describes him landing 'at a chosen location as a comet' with a slow and a zone — it out-ranges Galio's rank-1 rotation and is not single-target.
audit.corrected: Restated as a 4000-unit ally landing, with Grand Starfall's 5500 range acknowledged rather than dismissed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings claim 'his passive blocks your empowered Colossal Smash auto'.
audit.why: Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will: 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is EMPOWERED.' It blocks nothing. The damage block in his kit belongs to Aegis Assault (E), and Riot's text for it is 'becoming invulnerable to damage from the FRONT' — directional, not a passive auto-block.
audit.corrected: Mortal Will restated as an empowerment; the block reassigned to Aegis Assault and made directional.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aegis Assault appears nowhere in either layer, despite being the ability that eats a Galio all-in.
audit.why: Riot: Pantheon 'sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear.' It is 22/21/20/19/18 — the longest cooldown in his kit — and the block is FRONT-facing, so the counterplay is position or patience, not more damage.
audit.corrected: Written into mid, late, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], loading and tldr.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged that the entry 'never names any of Pantheon's abilities' and it is right — the content layer says 'his Q spear', 'point-click W stun', 'his passive' throughout.
audit.why: Mortal Will, Comet Spear, Shield Vault, Aegis Assault and Grand Starfall are the real names, with Comet Spear at 11s and 575 range and Shield Vault at 13s and an auto-attack reset.
audit.corrected: Names and numbers written into early, mid, late, spikes[0], whys[0], whys[1], wants.you[1] and wants.foe[0].

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are the only scary part of this lane — Pantheon is a pure early bully and Shield of Durand does almost nothing for you here because his damage is physical, not magic, so the channel's magic-amplified reduction barely blunts his Q spear. Respect that early poke: his passive blocks your retaliation Colossal Smash auto, so last-hit at the tip of Winds of War and don't walk up for a melee trade you can't win. Once he picks up his point-click W stun, never eat it in the open or he gets a free empowered Q follow-up. At 3, with Q-W-E all up, you finally have a counter — let him commit his stun and combo, channel Shield of Durand to tank the burst and release the taunt, then Justice Punch knockup to punish the over-extension.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are the only scary part of this lane — Pantheon is a pure early bully and Shield of Durand does almost nothing for you here because his damage is physical, so the channel's magic-amplified reduction barely blunts Comet Spear (Q, 11s at rank 1, 575 range). Respect that poke and last-hit at the tip of Winds of War rather than walking up for a melee trade. Once Shield Vault (W, 13s) is up, never eat that point-click stun-dash in the open — it is also an attack reset, so the stun arrives with a free empowered hit behind it. edits.before: Levels 4-5 the lane tilts your way as your combo cooldowns drop and his early burst stops killing you in a single trade. The W-taunt into E knockup is your whole gameplan against his all-in: he has to commit his stun and Q to kill you, and when you release Shield of Durand's taunt mid-combo you waste it into a damage-reduced sponge, then Justice Punch the knockup. At 6 you spike hardest — Hero's Entrance gives you a global rotation plus a taunt-knockup engage he can't answer, so even when a given trade is close, you swing other lanes while his only same-tempo play is his own ult on a single target.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 the lane tilts your way as your combo cooldowns drop and his early burst stops killing you in a single trade. The W-taunt into E knockup is your whole gameplan against his all-in: he has to commit Shield Vault and Comet Spear to kill you, and releasing the taunt mid-combo wastes it into a damage-reduced sponge. What you must not do is dump everything into Aegis Assault — Riot makes him invulnerable to damage from the FRONT during it, and it is 22 seconds at rank 1, the longest cooldown he owns. Go around it or wait it out. At 6, land Hero's Entrance on an ally within 4000 and swing another lane.

edits.before: This stays in your favour but flattens late — Pantheon falls off hard into items while you become a teamfight and roam machine, so your edge is map presence through Hero's Entrance, not a raw 1v1. Don't try to out-DPS a fed Pantheon in a vacuum; instead drop your R into fights, then W-taunt and Justice Punch to lock his squishies and soak his all-in for your carries. Close the game on your level 6 and first-item tempo so any early lead he scraped never has time to matter, and let your scaling team punish his fall-off.
edits.after: This stays in your favour but flattens late — Pantheon falls off hard into items while you become a teamfight and roam machine, so your edge is map presence through Hero's Entrance, not a raw 1v1. Don't try to out-DPS a fed Pantheon in a vacuum; drop your R onto an ally, then W-taunt and Justice Punch to lock his squishies. And never burn a combo into Aegis Assault: the block is directional, front-only, and 22 seconds long at rank 1 — step around him or wait. Close on your 6 and first-item tempo so any early lead never matters.

notes: The packet was right that no Pantheon ability was ever named, and the unnamed descriptions hid a fabricated mechanic: three strings say 'his passive blocks your empowered Colossal Smash auto'. Mortal Will does not block anything — Riot's text is 'every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered'. The block belongs to Aegis Assault, which appeared nowhere in either layer despite being the ability that eats a full Galio commit. And the block is DIRECTIONAL: Riot says 'invulnerable to damage from the FRONT', which the kit's derived flag overstates as plain untargetable, so the counterplay is position or the 22-second cooldown rather than more damage. DERIVED-FLAG MISFIRE, deliberately not written: _missing-interactions claims 'Your Justice Punch (E) shuts off Pantheon's Shield Vault, Grand Starfall'. That rule fires off a 'terrain' flag on Justice Punch, and Riot's description of Justice Punch is a step back and a charge that knocks up the first champion — it creates no terrain and grounds nothing, so no dash-denial claim was made.
